title: Turkish-Style Stir-Fried Chicken
description: A flavorful and spicy Turkish-inspired stir-fry dish made with juicy chicken and vegetables.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the garlic, Turkish pepper, onion, and bell pepper to the skillet. Cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the stir-fry sauce to the skillet and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 2-3 minutes.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
